profile.headline: Software Engineer | .NET, C#, TypeScript & AWS | Cloud and On-Prem Applications
profile.summary:
I’m a Junior Software Engineer working with C#, VB.NET, and the .NET framework to support and improve production systems at CenterEdge Software. I recently earned my Bachelor’s in Software Development and now spend my days diving deeper into real-world code, learning from my team, and getting hands-on experience with complex, production-level software.

Before tech, I worked in education, customer service, and the sciences - backgrounds that taught me how to stay adaptable, solve problems creatively, and communicate clearly. All of that still shows up in how I work today.

Right now, I’m focused on soaking up as much knowledge as I can and continuing to grow my skills in a team setting. Outside of work, I’m usually reading, hanging out with my bunny and cat, or enjoying the Florida sunshine.

Always happy to connect with others in tech - whether you're learning, building, or just sharing ideas.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Restore QuickBooks integration in Quantum by replacing deprecated third-party software, resolving licensing and configuration issues, and improving long-term maintainability.
Identify and resolve historical data flow errors by debugging VB.NET and C# libraries, ensuring accurate synchronization between Quantum and QuickBooks.
Establish and maintain a requirements list by gathering undocumented needs from management, defining project priorities, and aligning development with business objectives.
Conduct functional and design QA testing for the company’s new website, documenting usability and functionality issues, and submitting reports to management.
Deploy and configure a self-hosted Git server using Gitea on the company’s Windows server, enabling version control for internal development and improving code collaboration.
